title: Decentralized Arena: Towards Democratic and Scalable Automatic Evaluation of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the ranking results of individual LLM judges against a decentralized multi-LLM framework and human preference benchmarks (Chatbot Arena) to identify deviations, such as self-enhancement bias where models prefer their own outputs.
Varying the number and composition of judge models to evaluate whether a subset of models with similar training backgrounds or families introduces collective distortions into the evaluation rankings.
